notes.title: Special announcement: stepbystep release
notes.notes:
My new game stepbystep is released, you can check it out here

It is a turn-based programming puzzle platformer, hope you will enjoy!

notes.title: Release update 4
notes.notes:
Features:
> collision system is much more user-friendly now

notes.title: Release update 1
notes.notes:
Features:
> achievements progress
> gamepad "back" button support

Bug fixes:
> "one-try pro" achievement bug
> "dontbegreyed" achievement bug
> pause menu gamepad controls bug

Regression:
> linux achievements are unlocked on exiting the game, not instantly.
